pins.definition: Not busy, occupied, or in use; available.
Of a person or time: not busy with work or duties; off.
Of a person or time: not busy; having no plans or tasks.

situation: A person looks at a digital calendar on a tablet that shows a completely blank afternoon, while their colleague's screen next to them is packed with red overlapping blocks.
subject: the availability
brief: A close-up of two tablet screens side-by-side. The one on the left shows an afternoon schedule with no tasks or appointments, only a clean, bright, empty space. The one on the right is cluttered with dense, overlapping red blocks indicating a full schedule. The emptiness of the first screen is the focal point, emphasizing that the time is not busy and is available.
